address: 2F, 666 Chenhui Road, Xiaoshan, Hangzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: Diners are greeted by rows of live fish tanks at the entrance and various ingredients on display. A Xiaoshan native, the hands-on owner has been running this business for almost 20 years. You can ask him to recommend the catch of the day alongside other authentic Xiaoshan items made à la minute. Fish balls are one of his specialities but aren't available every day. The steamed buns made from scratch are the epitome of meticulous craftsmanship.
